description: Have the user's running page capture the user's screen now and solve the question, same as the "Solve from screenshot" button / hotkey; charged by the current mode and page count, with the answer shown on the user's page. The AI assistant does not (and cannot) supply the image. Runs in the desktop assessment overlay when the user is in an assessment (it must have started); otherwise in screenshot solving on the live / mock interview page (the web page must be sharing the screen). Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)
name: solve_screen_question
